description: Synthetic side-effect-unknown-truncate parity. Refusal messages come from the pinned blob. Plan results, fixture payload, and SessionEvent copies stay uncovered. No fixture diff is stored.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-side-effect-unknown-truncate-canonical: planner.plan is not run. A missing canonical codec call is not a successful plan. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_conservative_default_blocks_salvage checks a fingerprint for three fixtures. One fixture inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_opt_in compares a plan dict for three recipes. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_acknowledgement compares plan dicts. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications plans and then applies. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_interacting_multi_fault_session plans two recipes. No fingerprint is hashed and no fixture diff is stored. No output bytes are stored.

GAP-side-effect-unknown-truncate-session-copy: a SessionEvent prefix copies in the pin. This crate stops on that value. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications uses SessionEvent records from the fixture. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test.

GAP-side-effect-unknown-truncate-payload: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications and tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_interacting_multi_fault_session carry payload on the events. This set does not store payload content. A payload-free result is not that test. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_opt_in, tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_acknowledgement, and tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_conservative_default_blocks_salvage load the same fixture.

GAP-side-effect-unknown-truncate-bool: a True cut slices in the pin when the session length is greater than one. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that success. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed.

GAP-side-effect-unknown-truncate-float: a non-positive float cut and a float past the end are rendered with str in the pin. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that refusal. An in-range float raises TypeError before a slice. That TypeError is an extra vector and is not a whole pinned test.

GAP-side-effect-unknown-truncate-sweep: tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_salvage_recipe_applications applies three recipes and checks loss. One recipe inside a sweep is not the whole test. A successful truncate that also checks loss, plan, or canonical bytes is not covered by the event list alone. tests/repair/test_recipes_salvage.py::test_truncate_direct_apply_validation is three refusals of one function. The covered vector contains every refusal in that test.
